definitions.explanation: A mutual agreement reached between two or more parties, often in formal or legal contexts.

examples.japanese: {両者|りょうしゃ}は{合意|ごうい}に{達|たっ}した。
{合意|ごうい}の{上|うえ}で{離婚|りこん}した。
{合意|ごうい}{形成|けいせい}には{時間|じかん}がかかる。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合意|ごうい}に{達|たっ}する (to reach an agreement)
- {合意|ごうい}を{得|え}る (to obtain agreement)
- {合意|ごうい}{形成|けいせい} (consensus building)
- {合意|ごうい}の{上|うえ}で (by mutual consent)

USAGE NOTES:
- {合意|ごうい} emphasizes mutual agreement between parties.
- Often used in business, legal, and diplomatic contexts.

RELATED TERMS:
- {同意|どうい} - agreement (can be one-sided)
- {協定|きょうてい} - accord, pact
